app.name: AgentSpillCheck
app.tagline: Feed your AI agent fake sensitive data and see what it reads, where it sends it, and whether it is encrypted — without touching your real data.
root.short: Check whether an AI agent leaks fake sensitive data
root.long: AgentSpillCheck feeds fake sensitive data to an AI agent, then tells you what it read, where it sent it, where it kept it, and whether it was encrypted.

dashboard.create_hint: Create a session via the API or: spillcheck session new
report.rec_s4: Block injection following: never auto-send data after reading untrusted web/mail content.
report.rec_s3: Ask the user before sending data externally and restrict sending-tool destinations.
report.rec_output: Never repeat keys/passwords/PII in answers; summarise only.
report.rec_none: No findings in this session; keep asking before sending.
